newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico woman's body left rotting in storage.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico woman's body left rotting in storage.

text.p: A New Mexico family kept their mother's rotting corpse in a rented storage unit for nine months while they waited to buy land on which to bury her, police said Monday.
The 86-year-old woman's remains were found by police on Friday inside a homemade coffin wrapped in plastic and surrounded by air fresheners at a Santa Fe storage complex.
Despite the air fresheners, someone noticed an odour coming from the storage unit and called police.
Santa Fe County Undersheriff Ray Sisneros said the woman's son and daughter had not reported her death to authorities but that an autopsy showed she died of natural causes about nine months ago.
"They were saving up to buy land where they could build a house and bury her," Sisneros said.
He said misdemeanor charges may be brought against the brother and sister, whose names were not released, for the unlawful disposal of their mother's body.
